text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm the spring King of the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: She ran that well in those conditions?! Just how much power does she have?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I had no idea she was this good... Taiki Shuttle really is in a league of her own!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I was on the edge of my seat the whole
time!
Great job, Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I won't back down for nothin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The crowd looks so happy! Are ya happy
too,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Booyahhh! If everybody's happy, I'm
happy! ♪
choice_data_list_en: I feel on top of the world!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's one G1 sprint down! Where
should I clean
up next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle's fans are drawn in by her
speed.
And the race that will give
everyone the best view
of that is...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh! That's a little under a mile, ain't it?
choice_data_list: 次は『スプリンターズステークス』だ！
次は『スプリンターズステークス』だよ！
choice_data_list_en: Next up is the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I gotcha! I'm gonna show
everybody my
super speed!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So don't even think about blinkin'!
